system_prompt_style.note: Per-agent prompt templates with variables ({tools}, {input}, {agent_scratchpad}); Jinja-style loop in supervisor prompt.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote:
The Retriever Agent utilizes the RAG technique [24] to efficiently fetch specific
data from external resources provided by the user
env_context_strategy.note: RAG retrieval method (lexical vs embedding) unspecified; closest value chosen. Could be embedding_rag. Also web search via Researcher. Domain is control theory, not a repository.

context_compaction.note: Paper only; no code/config available where compaction would be declared.

observation_format.evidence_quote:
Observation: System Type: SS, Objective: poles, Ordered Tools: ['control.ss',
'control.poles'].
observation_format.note: Observations shown as text in ReAct transcripts.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote:
Action: the action to take, should be one of {agent_tools}.
Action Input: the input to the action.
tool_call_format.note: Actually ReAct-style 'Action:/Action Input:' text format parsed from output; no exact enum match, json_in_text closest.

tool_count.note: Controller Agent has 'more than 140 tools' (Sec. 3.2); exact count and per-agent split not reported.

edit_primitive.note: No tool registry available; file editing not a feature of this domain in paper.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: tool descriptions are provided through the tool functions, not the prompts
tool_schema_source.note: Tools wrap Python Control Library functions; schema derivation mechanism not shown.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote:
If the answer does not meet the necessary criteria, the Critic

Agent provides feedback for improvement, prompting the Controller Agent to refine the response.
loop_primitives.note: Each agent uses Thought/Action/Observation loop (App. A); critic-refine loop. Graph-routed supervisor.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote:
the Supervisor passes the query to the Planner Agent,
which organizes the sequence of functions (or tools) that the Controller Agent will use
planning_granularity.note: Planner outputs ordered tool list passed via message list; storage structure unclear.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote:
a supervisor LLM acts as the central decision-maker,
orchestrating a network of specialized LLM agents

delegation_mechanism.note: Shared message_list passed between graph nodes.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote:
Action: human_tool
Action Input: Please identify the format you prefer for the output file.
human_in_loop.note: Communicator asks user for output format; closest value, not strictly approval.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: If the answer is validated, it is stored efficiently by the Memory Agent for potential future use.
long_term_memory.note: Storage backend unspecified; stores full conversations and recalls them.

self_verification.evidence_quote:
Observation: The output does not align with the input. Similarity score: 0.55 (back
to controller agent).
self_verification.note: Critic agent with similarity threshold; Debugger for errors.
